move: mountain layers rise with parallax, sun lifts, title lands, layers sink
how: A sunset gradient sky with 60 seeded stars, a blurred radial sun and three SVG mountain silhouettes (front darker). The layers enter from y:160/240/320 (far to near) with expo.out over the first 32%, staggered 0.1s so the nearest arrives last; the sun rises from y:160/scale:0.6/opacity:0 (power3.out) and haze fades in, stars flicker in with a random-order stagger. Nav, two big uppercase headline lines (yPercent:110 line masks, expo.out, stagger 0.12), subtitle, pill CTA (back.out(1.6)) and three glass stat cards (y:60, expo.out, stagger 0.1, underline scaleX draws) land between 6% and 32%. From 20% to 100% the three layers drift x -20/25/-35 on sine.inOut for parallax, the sun keeps climbing y:-30, a small SVG bird flock crosses linearly from x:1000 to 640 and fades, cards bob y:-8 yoyo. Exit at 86%: headline shoots up, cards drop, the layers sink back into fog with expo.in (near first) and the sun sets with opacity 0.
adapt: Change brand, nav, the two headline words, subtitle, CTA labels and the three stat cards; recolour the sky gradient and the three mountain path fills, or replace the paths with your own silhouettes; keep the 1.6s expo.out layer rise with 0.1s stagger and the opposing sine drifts.
port: mount(el, shot) appends sky/stars (generated with fx.rng(7) or the engine's seeded rng)/sun/three SVG layers/birds/text/cards into el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with entrances in 0-0.32 of D, drifts spanning 0.2-1.0, exit from 0.86. All querySelector calls scoped to el.
caveats: stars are generated with fx.rng(7); port must use a seeded rng for determinism
